description.en: Adds a single party member with the standard "new member joined" presentation (BGM fades out for 30 frames, plays the "J_08" jingle, shows the "sysmes-add_party" message, then the BGM fades back in) — a fixed-preset wrapper around AddParty_MessageEx.
Param ID of the character to add to the party.
Whether to lock the member's position slot.
Whether to enable the member's Fighting Spirit.
Whether to lock the member's Fighting Spirit.
Level to set for the new member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

examples.case: Adding a member and setting their level (real usage, from ev42070500.nut)
examples.code:
// Add a party member with the standard recruitment presentation and set their level to 18
AddParty_Message("para_cp0015", true, false, false, 18);

examples.case: Adding a member without changing their level
examples.code:
// Add a party member with the standard recruitment presentation, keeping their current level
AddParty_Message("para_cp0015", true, false, false);
